thresholds.connection_status_rule: error <= exact_mm -> EXACT; <= near_mm -> NEAR; else MISMATCH; expected or actual missing -> NOT_COMPUTABLE
thresholds.relation_rule: path relation from distance to the selected junction (else to the insertion point): <= exact_mm exact; <= near_mm near; else unrelated
thresholds.expected_point_definition: centre of the fitting OPENING derived from block geometry (cap pair + rail edges), transformed by scale/rotation/insertion to WCS
thresholds.actual_point_definition: centre of the nearest generated Straight end face along the arm (Straight vertices in the arm corridor)
thresholds.units_note: all *_mm values are drawing units; the Router assumes millimetres (see insunits)

definitions.opening_center: midpoint of the two rail centres
